what: The full-screen Hero photo comes into focus from blur via WebGL. After a .2s pause, over 2.5s the 3×3 box-blur radius shrinks from 15 texels to 0 while mixing with the sharp photo (mix t), and opacity brightens quickly as 1−(1−t)² then settles for a long time. While blurred, the nine taps are divided by 10, so it is slightly dark. At 1.5s fx:done fires to signal when to turn on the header and menu. The photo is laid to cover the plate (cover)

options.dur: Settle-in duration (seconds), default 2.5 — work detail header photo is 2
options.delay: Delay from stick to start (s), default .2
options.done: Time after start until fx:done fires (sec), default 1.5
options.[data-fx-part=source]: Photo slot (img · canvas · video, optional) — if absent, a placeholder panel carrying the element’s data-label is drawn (--kf-raised background · --kf-line diagonal)
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]: Canvas to draw on (optional) — created and attached if missing

use: — Receives fx:done (bubble) and turns on the header
note: The original picks one of several photos per session in rotation (sessionStorage) and switches the heading text color (light or dark) per photo — picking and text color are the caller’s job. Once settled, drawing stops and it redraws only when the board size changes.
